title: Smart Data Models - Vehicle
description: This entity models a particular vehicle model, including all properties which are common to multiple vehicle instances belonging to such model.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be Vehicle

vehicleType.description: Property. Type of vehicle from the point of view of its structural characteristics.

battery.description: Property. The current percentage of battery left in case of an electric vehicle, or a device connected to the vehicle

category.description: Property. Vehicle category(ies) from an external point of view.

items.description: Property. Individual category items included for the vehicle

speed.description: Property. Denotes the magnitude of the horizontal component of the vehicle's current velocity and is specified in Kilometers per Hour.

heading.description: Property. Denotes the direction of travel of the vehicle and is specified in decimal degrees.

cargoWeight.description: Property. Current weight of the vehicle's cargo. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'Kilograms'

vehicleIdentificationNumber.description: Property. The Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) is a unique serial number used by the automotive industry to identify individual motor vehicles.

vehiclePlateIdentifier.description: Property. An identifier or code displayed on a vehicle registration plate attached to the vehicle used for official identification purposes.

fleetVehicleId.description: Property. The identifier of the vehicle in the context of the fleet of vehicles to which it belongs.

dateVehicleFirstRegistered.description: Property. The date of the first registration of the vehicle with the respective public authorities.

dateFirstUsed.description: Property. Timestamp which denotes when the vehicle was first used.

purchaseDate.description: Property. The date the item e.g. vehicle was purchased by the current owner.

mileageFromOdometer.description: Property. The total distance travelled by the particular vehicle since its initial production, as read from its odometer.

vehicleConfiguration.description: Property. A short text indicating the configuration of the vehicle, e.g. '5dr hatchback ST 2.5 MT 225 hp' or 'limited edition'.

feature.description: Property. Feature(s) incorporated by the vehicle.

serviceProvided.description: Property. Service(s) the vehicle is capable of providing or it is assigned to.

vehicleSpecialUsage.description: Property. Indicates whether the vehicle is been used for special purposes, like commercial rental, driving school, or as a taxi.

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

bearing.description: Property. Gives the vehicle GPS angle measured in a clockwise direction from the True North.

wardId.description: Property. Ward ID of the entity corresponding to this observation

tripNetWeightCollected.description: Property. The net weight collected by the vehicle corresponding to this observation at the end of the trip

license_plate.description: Property. Gives the License Plate number of the vehicle.

deviceBatteryStatus.description: Property. Gives the Battery charging status of the reporting device.

ignitionStatus.description: Property. Gives the ignition status of the vehicle. True means ignited

vehicleRunningStatus.description: Property. Gives the Battery charging status of the reporting device.

currentTripCount.description: Property. The current count of trips made by the vehicle corresponding to this observation on the given day of operation

zoneName.description: Property. Zone name of the entity corresponding to this observation

vehicleAltitude.description: Property. Gives the current altitude of the vehicle using GPS

observationDateTime.description: Property. Last reported time of observation

deviceSimNumber.description: Property. Gives the SIM number of the device in the vehicle

wardName.description: Property. Ward name of the entity corresponding to this observation

reportId.description: Property. Unique Id assigned for the issue or report or feedback or transaction corresponding to this observation

vehicleTrackerDevice.description: Property. Installation status of the GPS device or the tracking device fitted to the vehicle corresponding to this observation

fuelFilled.description: Property. Amount of fuel filled in liters to the vehicle corresponding to this observation

fuelEfficiency.description: Property. The distance traveled per unit of fuel used, commonly in kilometers per liter (km/L)

fuelType.description: Property. The type of fuel suitable for the engine or engines of the vehicle corresponding to this observation

serviceOnDuty.description: Property. Nature of service provided by emergency vehicle corresponding to this observation.

emergencyVehicleType.description: Property. Type of emergency vehicle corresponding to this observation.

municipalityInfo.description: Property. Municipality information corresponding to this observation

district.description: Property. District name corresponding to this observation

ulbName.description: Property. Name of the Urban Local Body corresponding to this observation

cityId.description: Property. City ID corresponding to this observation

wardId.description: Property. Ward ID corresponding to this observation

stateName.description: Property. Name of the state corresponding to this observation

cityName.description: Property. City name corresponding to this observation

zoneName.description: Property. Zone name corresponding to this observation

zoneId.description: Property. Zone ID corresponding to this observation

wardName.description: Property. Ward name corresponding to this observation

wardNum.description: Property. Ward number corresponding to this observation

leasingInfo.description: Property. Leasing contract information for the vehicle.

leasingStartDate.description: Property. Start date of the leasing contract

leasingEndDate.description: Property. End date of the leasing contract

monthlyLeaseCost.description: Property. Fixed monthly lease payment amount in the contract currency

allowedAnnualDistance.description: Property. Maximum allowed annual distance according to lease contract

allowedDistanceUnit.description: Property. Unit for distance measurements in the lease contract

excessDistanceCost.description: Property. Cost per unit distance for exceeding the allowed annual distance

leasingProvider.description: Property. Name or identifier of the leasing company
